statements.impact_statement: tar 0.4.40 is linked into sccache 0.18.0 only for creating archives (tar::Builder). The vulnerable behavior is in reading archives. tar::Archive is used only under src/bin/sccache-dist/, which requires the dist-server feature. The builder installs with --no-default-features and the image has no sccache-dist binary (asserted by assert-image.sh). Review by 2027-01-03, or on any sccache or tar version change.

The flaw is in unpacking crafted archives. sccache calls no unpack path outside sccache-dist, which is not built or shipped (see CVE-2026-33055). Review by 2027-01-03, or on any sccache or tar version change.

The flaw is PAX header desynchronization when reading a tar stream. sccache reads tar streams only in sccache-dist, which is not built or shipped (see CVE-2026-33055). Review by 2027-01-03, or on any sccache or tar version change.

The advisory requires a custom logger that calls into rand. sccache 0.18.0 source has no set_logger, set_boxed_logger or impl Log, and its only rand usage is OsRng and RngCore in four files. Review by 2027-01-03, or on any sccache or rand version change.

statements.action_statement: Accepted, not suppressed. bytes 1.10.1 is in sccache's server protocol path (BytesMut in src/server.rs). Supporting controls, not a proof of non-exploitability: the server binds 127.0.0.1 or a Unix socket, and the frame length is capped at 8 MiB. Upstream main still resolves bytes 1.10.1 and has no release after 0.18.0. Severity MEDIUM, below the HIGH gate. Review by 2027-01-03, or when sccache updates bytes.
